utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, did you hear? We're planning a neighborhood repair drive this weekend to fix up the community garden tools — it's going to be great!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds fantastic, Vik! I'm already helping Cleo sort tools tomorrow—want me to swing by and give you a hand setting up, too?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, thanks Sam! Yeah, come by anytime— we're starting Saturday morning at the garden shed. Bring your tools if you got 'em!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I'm planning on it. Got my toolbox ready and some extra work lights in case we need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good, Gus. I’ve got a wobbly chair and a loose hinge on the back door I could use help with.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rey. I've got clamps and a screwdriver set that'll handle both those jobs no problem.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Eli, I'm glad you're here. We're collecting tools for the repair drive—could you help sort through the donations?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course, Cleo. I like to keep things organized. What time should I come by on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: How about 9 AM on Saturday? That way we can get an early start before the crowd shows up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, is it this Saturday? I feel like I've already missed something again...

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Noah, you haven't missed it—it's definitely this Saturday. Let's meet tomorrow at 6 PM to sort out the details, alright?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, okay, tomorrow at 6. I'll try to remember—maybe I'll set an alarm this time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Leo's lawnmower is on the list, right? And I want to make sure—did we confirm if the hex wrenches are in his shed or here?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think the hex wrenches were in his shed... I remember seeing them by the old gas can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, I'll head over to Leo's shed to check for the hex wrenches before we start.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I think it's a great chance to fix up that old stuff we've got lying around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, yeah, I'm all for it—just don't be surprised if I roll in after you've started, you know how I am.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane—I'll save you a spot and a screwdriver. Just don't roll in too late, or I might have your chair fixed up before you get here!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, have you heard any more about that repair drive? I'm still hoping someone can fix my wobbly chair.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the deal with that repair drive—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, mostly small stuff like my wobbly chair, a broken toaster, and Jules mentioned some odds and ends.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm just worried we won't have enough hands or the right tools to pull this off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Don't you fret, Pia—I saw the repair truck parked near the old workshop on Maple, so they've got the big equipment ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief about the truck, but I still wonder if we'll have enough smaller tools for the volunteers to use at the same time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, I'll believe it when I see it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I know, right? I keep hearing different dates—Noah thought it might be last week, so who knows when it's actually happening.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so even the date is all mixed up? That makes me even more skeptical.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, you heard about the repair drive on Saturday? I'm bringing my old blender—those folks fixed a tractor on Elm Street, so I figure it's worth a shot!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'm heading to Mrs. Gable's at 9 on Saturday with a hammer to help patch her roof.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's nice of you, Bo! Mrs. Gable's roof has been needing fixing. Maybe after you're done, you could swing by the repair drive and see what else they're up to.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Leo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm rounding up the whole neighborhood to help out!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, I heard. I'll bring my broken lawnmower to get fixed.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo! I knew I could count on you. Can I count on you to spread the word to a few others too?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh! Let me catch you up — we've had a change of plans; the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, thanks for the update! I'll be there on Sunday at the community center—count me in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I've got you down for Sunday — thanks for being flexible with the change, Mara!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Nell, I'm helping organize the repair drive for the school. Do you have a moment to talk about scheduling?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hi Faye! Yes, I'd love to help out—what days are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great! I'm leaning towards this Saturday morning—does that work for you, or would a weekday afternoon be better?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Pia, there's been a little change! The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Sunday at the community center? That's good to know, but I hope we still have enough time to get the word out and round up the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia! I've already started calling around, and I think we'll manage just fine — I'll make sure everyone knows about the updated plan.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, they fixed a tractor? That's a whole different level of broken. You're sure about that?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I'm pretty sure I heard about it from Jules — they were saying it's this weekend, and now I'm really hoping someone can tackle my wobbly chair.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Jules? You mean the Jules who still thinks 5G towers cause headaches? I'll believe that tractor story when I see it myself.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm just waiting to hear more details. Might be able to help, but things are a bit... complicated right now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, yeah! It's this Saturday — we're fixing up the community garden tools. Not sure of the exact time yet, but it's gonna be great!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday... I'll try my best, but I might have to step out early if something comes up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, Dane, glad you're in! I've got my toolkit ready and I can clear out my garage if you need a staging area for the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late—figures, huh? But yeah, a staging area sounds perfect, I'll grab my tools and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, I'll swing by the garage and start clearing a spot. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're all set for tomorrow, just need to double-check the tool inventory.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, I'll bring my broken lawnmower then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Leo! I'll make sure we have the right tools for a lawnmower repair.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Mina! The repair drive is this Saturday, but I'm not sure of the exact start time. I saw the truck over on Elm Street earlier, so they're already getting started.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the deal with that repair drive—what exactly needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Well, I've noticed Mrs. Gable's fence is leaning, and the Johnsons' mailbox is hanging by a thread. Plus, that pothole on Maple Street could swallow a bicycle!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I left my toolbox somewhere... do you remember what we're fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I think we're just helping neighbors with small fixes—tools and volunteers are what Pia's worried about.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, small fixes. Well, I'm happy to help if I can find my toolbox... I hope I didn't leave it at the park again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Don't worry about the daylight, Pia. I'll bring some work lamps from my garage too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Gus, that's a great idea! I'll check with Ira and Noah to see if they know anyone else who might join in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Jules! The more hands we have, the better.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Mara. The repair drive... I think it's this Saturday? Or was it last week? I can't remember.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's this Saturday at 9 AM, Noah — at Mrs. Gable's on Elm Street. We'd love to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, this Saturday at 9. Got it. I'll try to be there—if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, I'm still waiting to hear back from someone about the exact start time on Saturday. I'd like to have that settled before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's at 9 AM sharp! I can swing by your place Saturday morning if you want a reminder.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9 AM sharp, perfect. I'll set my alarm, but thanks for the offer to remind me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: What seems to be wrong with it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, not sure exactly—something with the engine, I think. The guys are handling it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it. So we still need hex wrenches and a screwdriver, right? Let me double-check what's in Leo's shed before we head over.
